title: krmn K3: Commit invalid if any resulting member lacks a required component (rule 5)
description: mls-extensions #110 rule 5. check_staged_leaves (member.rs:1562-1573) checks only added/updated leaves; check every leaf of the resulting tree against the post-Commit GroupContext lists. Applies to Member commit/process and Observer process (so the hub). Regression test first: a Commit (mls-rs) whose AppDataUpdate/GCE tightens app_components beyond what an unchanged member lists is refused. See krmn design.
